explanation: Telgarsky Conjecture 6.3: for p ∈ (0, 1/2) and m = 2k, P[B(p,m) ≥ m/2] ≥ 1 − Φ((1/2 − p)√m/σ) + ½·C(m, m/2)·σ^m, with σ = √(p(1−p)). This matches the paper's statement. As a sanity check, I evaluated both sides numerically on a grid of p ∈ [0.01, 0.499] and k ≤ 300 and found no violations. The solved tag rests on a linked Logical Intelligence Lean proof. The statement is faithful.
